Axar Patel Welcomes Rishabh Pant's Return to Delhi Capitals

Rishabh Pant is set to return to the Delhi Capitals for the IPL 2027 season. Delhi Capitals captain Axar Patel has publicly expressed his full support for Pant, emphasizing that Pant will have complete freedom and face no additional pressure. Patel highlighted their long-standing mutual understanding and referred to Delhi as Pant's home. The captain reportedly learned of Pant's return after initially missing his calls.
